北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴热，体感 33℃。防晒补水，注意防暑哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is hot and sunny, feels like 33℃. Stay hydrated and protect yourself from the heat!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴朗有风，体感舒适。外出注意防晒防风哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and breezy, comfortable. Remember sun and wind protection!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 33℃ 略闷。建议清淡饮食，注意补水。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels stuffy at 33℃. Eat light, stay hydrated.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云湿热，湿度 91%。请保持清爽，注意除湿。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and humid at 91%. Stay cool and consider dehumidifying.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴好闷热，体感 32℃。记得防晒，多多饮水。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and muggy, feels like 32℃. Remember sunscreen and drink plenty of water.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，有 4级风。体感 31℃，外出多注意防晒！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny with 4-level wind. Feels like 31℃, remember sun protection!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴好闷热，湿度 86%。记得防晒，补充水分哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and humid at 86%. Remember sunscreen and stay hydrated.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天无风，湿度 100%。雨伞备好，注意防潮。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with no wind and 100% humidity. Keep an umbrella handy and stay dry.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴热，体感 33℃。防晒补水，小心中暑哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny and hot, feels like 33℃. Stay hydrated, prevent heatstroke!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗湿润，湿度 93%。感觉略闷，注意通风。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and humid at 93%. It feels a bit stuffy, ensure ventilation.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 30℃ 略闷。出行备伞，注意防潮。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels stuffy at 30℃. Bring an umbrella and mind the humidity.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 12℃，风力 6级。添衣防风，注意保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like 12℃ with strong winds. Dress warmly and mind the wind.
哈尔滨.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降12℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 6级

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 24℃。有 5级风，外出注意防风哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels like 24℃. With 5-level winds, mind the wind when out!
沈阳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降9℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天湿冷，湿度 90%。记得添衣，小心着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and damp-cold with 90% humidity. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天湿热，湿度 88%。保持清爽，出行备伞哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast and humid at 88%. Stay fresh and bring an umbrella.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴好，体感 31℃。记得防晒，多喝水解暑。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny, feels like 31℃. Remember sunscreen and drink water to beat the heat.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴热，有 4级风。体感 32℃，注意防晒补水！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny and hot with 4-level wind. Feels like 32℃, remember sun protection and hydration!
